_comment: Registry of official source files. build_refdata.py downloads any missing file, hashes it and records it in manifest.json. Never hand-type a regulatory value: parse it from one of these files.

dv_xlsx.title: CBAM default values, definitive period (information file for Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740 correcting (EU) 2025/2621)
dv_xlsx.legal_basis: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 as corrected by (EU) 2026/1740, Annex I and Annex IV
dv_xlsx.note: The Commission marks the Excel file as informational; the legally valid values are in the Official Journal text.

bm_xlsx.title: CBAM benchmarks, definitive period (information file for Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2620)
bm_xlsx.legal_basis: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2620, Annex section 5 (columns A and B)
bm_xlsx.note: The Commission marks the Excel file as informational; the legally valid values are in the Official Journal text.

guidance_3_pdf.title: Guidance No. 3 - CBAM methods for the calculation of emissions embedded in goods
guidance_3_pdf.legal_basis: Annex D reproduces Annex II section G of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547 (Methodology Act); section 4.10.1 states the default-value mark-ups

guidance_4_pdf.title: Guidance No. 4 - CBAM calculation of the free allocation adjustment
guidance_4_pdf.legal_basis: Table 2-1 (CBAM factor, CSCF) and Table 2-2 (benchmark indicator codes)

guidance_5d_pdf.title: Guidance No. 5d - Sector-specific guidance document on iron and steel
guidance_5d_pdf.legal_basis: Worked examples (section 4) used for golden tests; Table 3-1 extra parameters

guidance_2_pdf.title: Guidance No. 2 - Quick guide for non-EU operators on CBAM implementation

guidance_1_pdf.title: Guidance No. 1 - Introduction to CBAM concepts

cscf_decision_pdf.title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1862 of 23 July 2026 determining the uniform cross-sectoral correction factor (OJ L, 24.7.2026) - Spanish language version, equally authentic
cscf_decision_pdf.publisher: Official Journal of the European Union (copy served by BOE)

price_html.title: Price of CBAM certificates (web page snapshot)
